task.description:
git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0720-20260919 first. Write a fail-then-pass regression test proving ISS-0720's fix, per docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md Step 4's requirement: the test must be shown to FAIL against the pre-fix code and PASS against the post-fix code (checked out via a separate commit/worktree comparison, or reasoned via a mutation if the pre-fix state is awkward to check out -- your call, but the fail-first proof must be real and stated in your summary, not asserted).

Core regression test: set Application.put_env(:letflow, :oidc, keycloak_base_url: "https://iss0720-regression-test-authority.example") (restoring the original value in on_exit/1), ensure BPM_IDP_BASE_URL and KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL system env vars are NOT set during this test (use System.delete_env/put_env with on_exit restore, or confirm test env never sets them -- check first), then GET /api/tenant-config and assert the response's oidc_authority starts with "https://iss0720-regression-test-authority.example/realms/". Against PRE-FIX code (which reads the retired :issuer key, always nil, so falls through to the compiled localhost default since env vars are unset), this assertion fails -- the response would show localhost:8082, not the configured keycloak_base_url. Against POST-FIX code, it passes. This directly discriminates the exact bug ISS-0720/T-0138/ISS-0719 describes.

Also cover: the REVIEWER-flagged constraint that the new @allow_localhost_idp_fallback? compile-time flag cannot be runtime-toggled via Application.put_env/3 -- do not attempt to test the raise branch by flipping that flag at runtime; if you want coverage of the raise path, state explicitly in your summary why it either can or cannot be practically unit-tested given the compile-time mechanism, and if it cannot, that is an acceptable, explicitly-stated gap (not a step failure) since the flag's own correctness (false in prod/runtime.exs, true in dev/test.exs) was independently verified by SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER already via direct config-file inspection.

Add the test to test/letflow/routers/tenant_config_test.exs (existing file, artifacts_in) as new test case(s), following that file's existing conventions.
acceptance_criteria: New test in test/letflow/routers/tenant_config_test.exs asserts oidc_authority reflects a custom configured keycloak_base_url when BPM_IDP_BASE_URL/KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL are unset
Fail-then-pass proof is real and stated: confirmed FAIL against pre-fix tenant_config.ex, confirmed PASS against post-fix
Test cleans up any Application.put_env/System.put_env changes in on_exit/1, verified not to leak into other tests
Explicit statement on whether/why the compile-time-gated raise path is or isn't separately unit-testable
